title: Four record initializer
summary: Recovered the thiscall initializer at VA 0x439220: return this after setting each of four 20-byte records' +16 flag to one and +4/+8/+12 words to zero. Preserve +0 and +17..19. Direct original disassembly agrees with accepted reference; callers embed 80-byte blocks. No dependencies or global side effects.
test_description: Compare C++ directly with original_four_record20_initialize using GCC i386 thiscall: 256 uniform byte fills and 256 varying patterns, each initialized twice. Check both returned pointers, every output byte, all preserved words/trailing bytes, and 16-byte guards on either side against independent expectations.
known_limits: Original class and field names and precise field semantics remain unresolved; neutral fixed-width storage models the observed layout.
Requires a valid writable 80-byte object; null and invalid storage are outside the contract. No concurrency or fault-path guarantees are inferred.
Behavioral recovery only; no byte matching claimed.
